summary: Implemented E3052, E3053 and E3054 as keyword rules in src/cfnlint/rules/resources/ecs/ (ServiceNetworkConfiguration.py, TaskDefinitionAwsVpc.py, ServiceFargate.py), with unit tests test_service_network_configuration.py, test_task_definition_aws_vpc.py and test_service_fargate.py in test/unit/rules/resources/ecs/. All 71 ECS tests pass when run with PYTHONPATH=src. The full unit suite passes except test_build_graph, which needs pydot or pygraphviz that the shared venv lacks, and test/unit/module/formatters, which needs defusedxml, also missing. Black and ruff were not run because they are not installed in the venv; six lines exceed 88 columns (string literals only). Nothing is committed; the six new files are untracked.
